Bug_Title: STI: Static Thread.interrupted() method invoked on thread instance (STI_INTERRUPTED_ON_UNKNOWNTHREAD)
Bug_Details:
This method invokes the Thread.interrupted() method on a Thread object that appears to be a Thread object that is
not the current thread. As the interrupted() method is static, the interrupted method will be called on a different
object than the one the author intended.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by calling the static method Thread.interrupted() on an instance of Thread, which is misleading. The method is intended to be called in a static context to check if the current thread has been interrupted.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method which in turn incorrectly uses the Thread.interrupted() static method on the thread instance instead of the static context. This misuse is verified by the failing assertion as the method returns a misleading result.
